description: Shorti(쇼티) for «what should I shoot this week?» or «이번 주 뭐 찍지?». Today's rising hits, then this week's formats, its picks first. `category` narrows it («이번 주 음식»: 'food'). A hit (`today`): its age, country, platform, views, format. A format: what its videos do, its strongest video, its spread and page; a pick names its recent hit. Signed in, their week leads. Then shorti_format(format_id).

category.description: The creator's niche, when they have one.

lang.description: 'en' answers in Shorti's own English: never translate its Korean.

platform.description: Only formats with videos on this platform.

name: shorti_what_to_shoot

for_you.description: true when a signed-in reader's own week leads the list

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

today.description: today's rising hits, newest first, the asker's side first

week.description: the Monday (KST) the week's picks are fixed on

title: What to shoot this week
